name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio: Jean-Pierre's path to motorsport security was anything but conventional. After a brief stint as a military police officer, he transitioned into private security, where his meticulous nature and calm demeanor quickly made him an asset. A chance encounter with a former racing engineer ignited his passion for motorsport, leading him to specialize in track and team security. His approach is proactive, emphasizing prevention and preparation over reaction. He distinguishes himself by his deep understanding of both security protocols and the unique pressures of the racing environment.

physical.description: Jean-Pierre is of average height, with a lean build and watchful eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down potential security risks.
Has a habit of adjusting his tie, even when he's not wearing one.
Speaks fluent Dutch, French, and English, often switching between languages mid-sentence.
